supervisor.launch_model: The running UI starts one process-group-isolated runner on demand for one checked execution snapshot; no always-running run-loop daemon exists.
supervisor.health_interface: UI status plus the exact active-run ownership record under ~/Library/Application Support/Perplexity CPU Loop/active-run.json; process identity must match runner path, snapshot, owner token, PID and process group.
supervisor.persistence: Supervisor remains available for the lifetime of the interactive UI process. It is not registered as an automatically restarting launchd service.

execution.lifecycle: One process per request; the supervisor creates an atomic ownership record before launch, updates PID/PGID after launch, and clears it only after the matching process finishes.

protocol.switch_safety: The future activation must atomically change the selector and reject legacy mutation; this readiness record proves only that the current selector and rollback boundary are identifiable.

restart_and_recovery.normal_restart: The supervisor launches a fresh one-shot runner for the retained checked snapshot.
restart_and_recovery.crash_detection: An ownership record without a matching live process is recoverable; a matching detached process is monitored; multiple or mismatched owners fail closed.
restart_and_recovery.request_recovery: If launch fails before ownership transfer or the runner exits before consuming the snapshot, the exact snapshot is restored and Auto Mode is disabled.
restart_and_recovery.supervisor_restart: Restart the UI from the tracked `_src/perplexity-cpu-loop.js` source and recover only the exact token/path-bound active-run record; do not use broad process-name killing.

rollback.source: Stop the exact token/PID/PGID-bound runner, restore the previously pinned runner and supervisor source digests on an isolated branch, requalify, then promote by expected-base compare-and-swap.
rollback.protocol: Before queue activation, keep `legacy-writable` plus `runner-request@v1`. A failed 0037-46.02 activation restores the prior selector epoch and singleton source before another mutating request is accepted.
prohibitions: no git reset --hard in a shared or dirty checkout
no broad pgrep/kill by process name
no simultaneous legacy and queue mutation acceptance

configuration_authority.current_user_authority: May configure the host supervisor, credential handles and protocol selector subject to the Task contracts and signed decision records.
configuration_authority.sandboxed_agent_boundary: May publish bounded requests only; cannot control the supervisor, private credential paths or protocol selector directly.
configuration_authority.revocation: Disable Auto Mode, stop only the exact ownership-bound process group, retain/restore any checked snapshot, revoke affected credential handles, and record the selector/policy change.

host_checkout_provisioning.purpose: Recreate the historical /private/tmp/autodocs checkout after temporary-storage reaping.
host_checkout_provisioning.qualification_boundary: The tracked provision_tmp_worktree.sh is marked superseded and is not a safe worker-clone mechanism. It is not counted as runner persistence or future queue deployment capability.

covered_controls: process termination and clean one-shot restart
